# HealthSync watch shell: implementation and device acceptance

Watch 2.4.0 / Phone 2.3.0, prepared 9 October 2026. Version codes are Watch 16 and Phone 10. This delivery strengthens caller identity, Telecom companion call controls, actual supported call audio routing, screen-off alerts, message details, reconnect reconciliation and reply confirmation. Existing heart-rate acquisition, display and tracking rules are retained. The user identifies the watch as Kolabee U8 Ultra; its firmware, HFP call connection, sensor access and physical behavior remain unverified. See [communication setup and device checks](COMMUNICATION-SETUP.md).

The watch app now provides a unified watch Home experience. The center clock, app grid, control shade, notification cards, fitness tiles, face picker, media controls and settings are surfaces in one Activity. Installed apps and detailed workout/system screens keep their normal Android task behavior. Selecting HealthSync as Home is optional and user controlled.

## Implemented

| Area | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Home | Sixteen faces: Orbit, Analog, Minimal, Casio Circular, Sport, Blueprint, Solar, Typography, Terminal, Full Analog, Roman, Pure Digital, Casio Pure, Health Rings, Classic LCD and Dashboard. Casio Circular uses a round bezel and seven-segment LCD. Full Analog, Roman, Pure Digital and Casio Pure always omit the bottom shortcut row. Other faces provide real battery/phone/step/heart states, unread badge, workout and timer glances according to their layout. |
| Navigation | Up opens Apps; down Controls; left Notifications; right Fitness; hold opens the face picker. Panels follow the finger, accept distance/velocity thresholds, and cancel short drags. Left-edge swipe and hardware Back unwind navigation. Clock shortcuts starts on for the original twelve faces and can be disabled in Settings → Display & AOD; swipes remain available without the bottom buttons. Dashboard reserves central vertical scrolling and opens its picker through Settings. |
| Apps | Adaptive icon grid with All, Pins and Recent; stable component identity; long-press pin/app information; installed app refresh; rotary scrolling. Builtin Health, Music, Notifications, Tools and Settings routes. |
| Controls | Actual Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, DND, battery, airplane and power-saver state. Wi-Fi/Bluetooth direct changes only where Android permits; special access or system screens elsewhere. Sound sliders, per-window brightness, screen flashlight and AOD. Flashlight restores its display settings when closed or paused. |
| Notifications | Bounded persistent Phone/Watch inbox with filters and saved details. Manage in launcher starts enabled; granted, connected watch access saves supported clearable source notifications before canceling Android's copy. Mirrored phone messages can wake unlocked compatible legacy watches and open popups even while management is enabled; newer background delivery uses private high-priority banners. Popup/wake/channel settings, DND and lockscreen privacy apply. Available native open/actions and source-app recovery routes are offered; action handles can expire after cancellation/restart. Phone replies require a connection and current original reply action. Correlated phone results distinguish sending, app submission, failure and unknown timeout. Removed/filtered notifications and disconnects revoke stale actions; active snapshots restore them quietly. Clear all clears across all filters (with confirmation in the separate searchable inbox), removes saved phone copies without canceling originals, dismisses clearable watch alerts and retains ongoing/non-clearable watch alerts. |
| Calls | Contacts/Telecom/dialer identity, per-call controls and confirmations, explicit Android 12+ companion watch association, permission-gated legacy answer/end, bounded visible ring vibration, independent incoming call channel/full-screen eligibility, real route and timer state, exact watch HFP selection and other-headset labels. Audio requires firmware Bluetooth Calls support. |
| Phone source picker | All apps, System and Selected views, label/package search, installed system services without launcher icons, observed and selected source preservation. All apps includes system alerts; turn off the master switch for individual selection. The sideload inventory uses QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES; future store distribution requires separate permission review. |
| Fitness | Step goal ring, reliable last heart rate with its age, daily saved workout totals, active workout, measurement and history routes; eight existing exercise modes and persisted workout recovery. Exercise sampling requires recent readings; missing sensors/access and acquisition failures are explicit. Location providers recover after enabling/permission changes, and route gaps remain separate. |
| Phone controls | Paired phone battery, supported media transport/metadata and Find phone. Controls use phone-confirmed responses; no active session or unavailable permission is shown honestly. Find phone rings for at most 15 seconds, offers Stop on both devices, and uses the phone's current sound policy. |
| Tools | Persisted countdown, pause/resume/cancel, system notification alert and Home glance; stopwatch/laps; system alarm-app route. Exact alarm access is requested only where required; denied access is clearly approximate. There is no countdown-long wake lock. |
| Display | Clock shortcuts controls the bottom dock or Exercises/Menu row on the original twelve faces; the four clean faces always hide it. Eight AOD styles: Match watch face, Digital, Analog, Outline, Stacked, Retro LCD, Dial Rings and Date Focus. Idle choices 15/30/60 seconds; brightness 1/3/6/10 percent. Defaults: matching face, 15 seconds, 3 percent. Black sparse display, minute updates, pixel shifting and touch-to-brighten. Optional low-rate motion sensing only while this dim clock is foreground. Wallpaper picker/backdrop where firmware supplies it. |
| Software bezel | Optional foreground-service overlay after display-over-apps grant, transparent circular center, black outside mask, touch pass-through and 100/95/90/85 percent diameter choices. Opaque on Android 8; translucent within Android's touch-opacity limit on Android 12+. Settings and service notification provide Turn off. |
| Recovery | Home selection/restoration, another available launcher, Android Settings, permission and battery settings, device/API/display/sensor report. Clock and recovery screens work offline. |

Watch inbox schema 3 additively preserves v1/v2 Phone/Watch entries and stores active notification metadata plus reply request/results. Both apps retain their application IDs and existing development certificate. Install Watch 2.4.0 and Phone 2.3.0 together for the complete communication protocol. Existing fitness message types remain compatible.

## Platform boundaries

The launcher can own the Home interface. It cannot acquire firmware privileges by becoming Home.

| Requested OS behavior | Supported boundary |
| --- | --- |
| True low-power AOD | Current AOD keeps a visible Activity awake and dims it. Factory display doze requires a verified firmware/vendor integration. Opening another app releases the clock's display retention. [Android screen retention](https://developer.android.com/develop/background-work/background-tasks/awake/screen-on) |
| Screen wake | Wrist raising brightens only the foreground dim clock. Incoming messages request a bounded wake and popup on compatible unlocked Android 8 watches; newer background messages use a private banner. Calls use Android full-screen permission/eligibility. Secure locks, DND, force-stop and firmware power management still apply. |
| Immortal Home/services | Android may stop any process. Persisted state, guarded foreground work and reconnection are used for recovery; force-stop and vendor cleaners still apply. [Process lifecycle](https://developer.android.com/guide/components/activities/process-lifecycle), [foreground-service restrictions](https://developer.android.com/develop/background-work/services/fgs/restrictions-bg-start) |
| All system toggles | Modern Android restricts direct Wi-Fi/Bluetooth changes; DND requires policy access. Airplane/saver use guarded system screens. Global brightness is not changed. [Wi-Fi restrictions](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/net/wifi/WifiManager#setWifiEnabled(boolean)), [Bluetooth restrictions](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/bluetooth/BluetoothAdapter#enable()) |
| Phone and watch notifications | A listener observes its own host device. Separate phone/watch grants are required, and phone notifications travel over Bluetooth. [Notification listener](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/service/notification/NotificationListenerService) |
| Complete system notification replacement | Launcher management excludes ongoing/non-clearable notifications, group summaries and prompts with delete callbacks, remote-input actions or full-screen intents. Bluetooth alerts can be handled when Android exposes supported notifications/actions. Heads-up may briefly appear; permission dialogs, secure screens and mandatory foreground-service indicators remain Android controlled. |
| Universal app clipping | The bezel hides corners without resizing another app, so outside controls may be hidden. Secure/protected apps can hide overlays; Android 12+ touch rules require translucency. Display-over-apps permission and foreground-service availability remain required. |
| Stock/vendor faces | An exported factory launcher can be opened. Embedding its private engine or importing ClockSkin requires actual permitted samples and a verified interface. No vendor engine support is claimed. |
| All health sensors | Only readings exposed through compatible Android/vendor APIs are available. No oxygen/sleep/heart values are synthesized. The user identifies the watch as Kolabee U8 Ultra; firmware, display type and physical sensor access remain unverified. Heart-rate details report exposed sensors, registration outcomes and rejected frames. |
| Calls, alarms and media | Modern call controls use the explicitly associated companion InCallService; older public answer/end APIs require call permission. Watch audio requires the exact connected device in Android supported Bluetooth call devices. Private HFP client privileges are not fabricated. Alarms need an installed handler; media needs a controllable session. |

## Validation and next device gate

Current evidence belongs in validation/communication-2.4.0/ and dist/BUILD-REPORT-Android8-2.4.0.md. The report records completed build, tests, lint, signing and package checks. No real device or emulator was connected for this delivery. Earlier validation applies to its respective APKs and does not establish runtime validation for this build.

On the real watch:

1. Upgrade both APKs while preserving data; record actual model/build/API, resolution/density, sensor inventory and Bluetooth Classic support.
2. Test the normal app entry first, then select Home. Open Android Settings and installed apps; restore the factory Home through the recovery screen. Keep that launcher installed.
3. Test all gestures, sixteen faces, eight dim clock styles and every idle/brightness choice. Select Full Analog, Roman, Pure Digital and Casio Pure and confirm they have no bottom shortcut row. Turn Clock shortcuts off/on in Settings → Display & AOD for the other twelve faces; confirm the preference persists and swipes still reach every panel with the row hidden. Check long-press faces/apps, child scrolling, edge Back, physical Home/Back/crown, and font settings inside the round bezel. Grant overlay access; test diameter choices, touch pass-through, permission revocation, Turn off and protected screens with the software bezel.
4. Grant watch Notification Access and verify real local/Bluetooth alerts, supported native actions, protected/ongoing prompts and management on/off. Grant phone access; verify All apps/System/Selected source selection, mirroring and supported replies. Verify Clear all across filters, ongoing retention, original phone alert preservation, source isolation, disconnect and restart history/action recovery.
5. Test supported phone media, no-session state, Finder start/Stop/timeout, Android sound policy, incoming calls and actual call audio.
6. Run timers while screen-off and after reboot; verify exact/approximate access states and Stop alert. Check stopwatch laps and process recovery.
7. Run each workout through pause/resume, screen-off and app switches. Check saved timestamps, duplicates and interrupted recovery.
8. Compare battery and temperature over equal workloads with AOD/wrist off/on. Record duration, firmware, brightness and permissions; do not infer universal battery claims from an emulator.

USB/firmware-supported ADB and `tools/Install-Watch-Diagnostic.ps1 -Serial WATCH_SERIAL -CheckStartup` can collect upgrade/startup evidence. The helper targets the current watch APK, preserves app data, and does not select Home automatically.
